stories.title: Police officer suspended over rape allegation:Woman claims he forced her into a live-in relationship and later an abortion
stories.summary: A woman in Bareilly has accused a sub-inspector of rape and assault, alleging he exploited her after she approached a police station to complain about a dispute with her husband. According to the woman, the officer initially showed sympathy before promising to marry her and help her secure a job. She alleged that he told her, "You are very beautiful, I will leave my wife for you," and kept her with him for nearly a year by repeatedly assuring her that they would marry. On Tuesday at around 4 pm, the woman reached the Senior Superintendent of Police's office and demanded that an FIR be registered against the sub-inspector, as well as his wife and sons. The SSP said the complaint is under investigation. The sub-inspector has been suspended pending the inquiry. Woman reached the police station after a fight with her husband The woman, a resident of Baradari police station area, said - I have been having disputes with my husband since 2022. I am living separately from my husband. In 2025, I went to Baradari police station with a complaint against my husband and in-laws. There, I met Sub-Inspector (Daroga) Naresh Babu, who was posted at the police station. The sub-inspector first listened to my problem, then assured me of help. He claimed that he had a good hold in the police department. Due to direct connections with the captain, he could get me a job. Along with this, he also promised to divorce his wife and marry me. Now read the woman's allegations Made relations by luring with marriage: After assuring marriage, Sub-inspector Naresh Babu started staying in contact with me. He also started coming and going to my house. Later, he had physical relations with me several times. I kept trusting the sub-inspector's words, because I believed he would marry me. Since last year's Karwa Chauth, Sub-inspector Naresh Babu started living with me at my house. Took jewellery worth 8 lakhs by making an excuse of son's marriage: In February 2026, Sub-inspector Naresh Babu, citing his son's marriage, took gold jewellery worth about 8 lakh rupees from me. Later, when I asked for the jewellery back, he started procrastinating. When I protested, he started threatening me. Forced Abortion: Meanwhile, I became pregnant. When the sub-inspector found out about this, he forcibly made me take abortion pills on May 12. After taking the medicine, my health deteriorated. Due to this, I had to be admitted to the hospital. Arrived home with wife and sons, assaulted: On May 23, Sub-Inspector Naresh Babu arrived home with his wife and sons. He also abused and assaulted me. Upon this, I informed Dial-112. However, before the police arrived, they fled after threatening to kill me. Sub-inspector's family behaved rudely: On the night of July 4/5, the sub-inspector was injured in a road accident. Upon learning this, I admitted him to the hospital and also bore the cost of treatment. The next day, his family members behaved rudely with me at the hospital. Additionally, the sub-inspector also ended his relationship with me. Showed police authority: The sub-inspector intimidated and threatened me by citing his influence and connections in the police department. He said that he himself is a policeman. No action will be taken against me. Because of this, I could not gather the courage to complain for a long time.

stories.title: Raids on properties of former SP MLA close to Akhilesh:ED carries out searches in suspected money laundering case
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) raided three properties belonging to former SP MLA Deep Narayan Singh Yadav on Wednesday morning. The ED reached a flat of the former MLA in Jhansi and two in Lucknow at 7 AM. The ED is investigating Deep Narayan's properties and financial transactions in a suspected money laundering case. The former MLA has an ancestral home in Moon City, Jhansi. Simultaneously, two flats located in Eldeco Colony and Sunrise Apartment on Kanpur Road in Lucknow were raided. According to sources, the raiding team comprised more than 20 officers and staff. Force was deployed outside all three locations. No one is being allowed to enter or exit. Deep Narayan is close to SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. Sources claimed that a raid also took place at the residence of a close relative of Deep Narayan. Full details related to the raid have not yet emerged. Two pictures of the ED raid Former MLA's whereabouts not clear Sources said that the ED team is searching room by room and family members present were interrogated. However, it is not yet clear where the former MLA was during the raid. According to sources, this action by the ED has been taken on the basis of an FIR by the Uttar Pradesh Vigilance Establishment. It is being said that 23 FIRs are registered against the former MLA. An extortion and robbery case was registered on 20 November On 20 November 2025, Prem Singh Paliwal, a resident of Bhujond village, accused Deep Narayan and his associate Anil Yadav, a resident of Akhadapura, of robbery and extortion. An FIR was registered against them at Moth Police Station the same day. Police announced a ₹25,000 reward for information leading to Anil Yadav's arrest. On 12 December, Anil Yadav surrendered before the court. ₹25,000 reward announced for Deep Narayan Meanwhile, Deep Narayan remained absconding and police continued searching for him. He filed a bail plea before the Jhansi court, but it was rejected. Following the court's order, property worth ₹20 crore belonging to Deep Narayan was attached on 13 December. Police had also announced a ₹25,000 reward for information leading to his arrest. Reached court on a motorbike to surrender He filed another application to surrender before the court on 15 December but did not appear, seeking another date through his lawyer. The court granted him time until 20 December. On 20 December, he arrived at the court riding pillion on the motorbike of his lawyer, Zahid Mansoori. He surrendered before the court, which subsequently remanded him to 14 days in judicial custody. Later, police sought eight hours of custody to recover the looted money, but the court granted six hours instead. Police claimed recovery of ₹15,000 from his house After securing custody, police took him to Budhawali village in Moth, his ancestral village. They claimed to have recovered ₹15,000 in cash, allegedly part of the robbery proceeds, from his house. He was then taken back to jail, where he remained lodged. Last seen at a press conference yesterday He was granted bail by the court on 7 May. Since then, he had been staying at his residence in Moon City. On Tuesday, Ballia-based leader Sanatan Pandey visited Jhansi and addressed a press conference at the Circuit House. Deep Narayan was also present at the event. stories.title: NIA raids cosmetic trader's home over terror funding:Agency raids premises of 3 brothers; cash-counting machine brought in during search
stories.summary: The National Investigation Agency (NIA), assisted by local police and central security forces, carried out simultaneous raids on Wednesday (8 July) morning at the homes of cosmetics businessman Abdul Qadir and his two brothers in Bulandshahr. The trio is under investigation for alleged hawala transactions, terror funding and money laundering. Teams that reportedly arrived from Visakhapatnam in three vehicles launched coordinated searches at all three properties in the city's Intarodi locality at around 8.30 am. The searches are still underway at the time of reporting, with officials said to have recovered a large quantity of cash from the residences of Abdul Qadir, Faisal and Bilal. Cash counting machines brought in as searches continue According to reports, currency counting machines were requisitioned from banks to process the recovered cash. Police personnel from two police stations have been deployed at the site while the counting operation continues. Security agencies have sealed off the Intarodi neighbourhood and adjoining areas, restricting all movement. Outsiders have been barred from entering the locality, while those already inside the raided premises have not been allowed to leave until the operation is completed. See pictures... Recent foreign trip comes under NIA scanner Investigators suspect that Abdul Qadir, who recently returned from abroad, may have links to an alleged money laundering, terror funding and hawala network. Acting on intelligence inputs, the NIA launched coordinated searches at his residence and other linked locations. Raid continues under magistrates' supervision SP City Abhishek Pratap said, “The NIA investigation is still in progress. The search operation is being conducted under the supervision of two magistrates, with officials continuing to examine evidence at the raided premises”.

stories.title: UP teachers to receive accident insurance cover upto ₹1cr:State also launches ₹5 lakh cashless healthcare scheme
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Wednesday announced a comprehensive insurance and healthcare package for teachers and education department employees. The scheme includes accident insurance of up to ₹1 crore and cashless medical treatment of up to ₹5 lakh for nearly 12 lakh teachers across the state. Speaking at an event on Wednesday morning, the Chief Minister said that permanent teachers and employees will receive ₹10 lakh under Group Term Insurance, ₹1 crore Personal Accident Cover, ₹1 crore Permanent Disability Cover, and up to ₹1.60 crore Air Accident Insurance Cover in the event of an accident. He added that contractual employees earning more than ₹10,000 per month will also be covered, with personal accident insurance ranging from ₹30 lakh to ₹80 lakh. Employees earning less than ₹10,000 per month will receive ₹2 lakh accident insurance cover. Yogi said the scheme also provides financial support for the education of employees' children and the marriage of their daughters if a teacher or employee dies in an accident. He described the initiative as a first-of-its-kind programme, saying Uttar Pradesh is the first state to introduce such comprehensive protection for teachers. The Chief Minister also launched a cashless healthcare scheme providing treatment worth up to ₹5 lakh for around 12 lakh teachers. He said the state government will bear the entire annual cost of approximately ₹450 crore, with no contribution required from teachers. "We do not want anything from you except Guru Dakshina," Yogi said. “Our only expectation is that you focus on educating children. Schools should have a clean, positive environment that helps shape the country's future.” Before the event, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath was welcomed with Vedic chants by 51 young priests (Batuks). He also visited an exhibition put up by schoolchildren. Looking at a telescope model, he jokingly asked a student, "Can this telescope show me the ministers sitting in Lucknow from here?" The Chief Minister had first announced the insurance scheme on Teachers' Day in 2025. The benefits will be extended to teachers, Shiksha Mitras, instructors, cooks and hostel wardens. Addressing the gathering, Secondary Education Minister Gulab Devi praised the Chief Minister and said that no one involved in the alleged theft of offerings at the Ram Mandir would be spared. She said the Chief Minister had constituted a committee to investigate the case, ensuring that no matter how influential or senior a person might be, they would not escape action. According to her, the move has been widely appreciated not only in Uttar Pradesh but across the country. Referring to the 2025–26 board examinations, Gulab Devi said that around 5.4 million students appeared for the exams and no cases of cheating were reported. She credited the state government's strict measures, saying they were so effective that cheating mafias did not dare to interfere and no examination papers were leaked.

stories.title: Police take 3 Ram Mandir donation theft accused into remand:CCTV shows them pocketing donation cash; Govind Dev meets Champat Rai
stories.summary: Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation theft case accused Lavkush Mishra, Anukalp Mishra and Karunesh Pandey have been taken into 40-hour police remand. A police team reached Faizabad Jail at 7:36 am on Wednesday and took the three accused to the Police Lines. According to the SIT report, CCTV footage shows the trio allegedly pocketing currency notes. Meanwhile, Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust Treasurer Swami Govind Dev Giri has reached to meet Champat Rai. Rai is staying in seclusion at Teerth Kshetra Puram near the Ram Mandir in Ramkot. On Tuesday, he broke his silence through a letter, saying all allegations against him are false. The SIT has also begun examining expenses related to major events organised by the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust. Investigators are scrutinising bills and vouchers for the Ram Mandir consecration ceremony held on 22 January 2024 and the flag-hoisting ceremony on 25 November 2025. Records show ₹113 crore was spent on the consecration ceremony, attended by around 8,000 guests, while ₹10.12 crore was spent on the flag-hoisting event.

stories.title: Heavy rain sweeps across 10 UP cities:Delivery boy swept into drain in Mathura, 68 cities remain on alert
stories.summary: The monsoon has gathered pace in Uttar Pradesh. Rain is falling in 10 cities, including Mathura and Ghaziabad, on Wednesday morning. In Hathras, heavy rain has left roads submerged in waist-deep water. The current is so strong that cars and motorbikes are being swept away. Cloud cover persists across most districts of the state, while light winds have made conditions more humid. The weather department has issued a rain alert for 68 districts today, with 12 of them likely to receive heavy rainfall. On Tuesday, rain lashed 50 cities, including Lucknow and Prayagraj, from the morning onwards. In Mathura, overflowing drains swept away a delivery rider along with his motorbike. Local residents managed to pull him to safety. Sonbhadra recorded the highest rainfall in the past 24 hours at 31 mm, which is 195% above the normal 10.5 mm. Despite the recent showers, Uttar Pradesh has received 45% less rainfall than normal since 1 June.

stories.title: File Income Tax return by 31st July to avoid penalty:Check your ITR refund status in mins, filing is easier than before; CA not required
stories.summary: The last date for filing the Income Tax Return (ITR) is July 31. If you don't file an ITR within the stipulated time, you may have to pay a late fee of ₹1 thousand on annual income up to ₹5 lakh and up to ₹5 thousand on income exceeding ₹5 lakh. The Income Tax Department has made the ITR filing process much easier through the e-filing portal. Now you can easily file ITR yourself from home. The purpose is that people don't have to depend only on Chartered Accountants (CA) every time for filing returns. First, understand the new and old tax regimes According to Chartered Accountant Deepak Tiwari, if you are filing ITR for Assessment Year 2026-27, first know that the new tax regime is now the default. If you don't choose any option, the system will automatically put you in the new tax regime. Therefore, it is important to know which regime to choose. In the new regime, income tax is zero on income up to ₹12 lakh In the new tax system, the government has increased the scope of tax exemption. Now there is no direct tax on income up to ₹4 lakh. After this, if your total taxable income is up to ₹12 lakh, then the government gives a tax rebate of up to ₹60,000 under Section 87A. Due to this, your entire tax is waived, and you don't have to pay any tax. Apart from this, salaried people also get a standard deduction of ₹75 thousand. This means if your annual salary is up to ₹12.75 lakh, then after the standard deduction, your taxable income remains ₹12 lakh. In such a case, you get the benefit of a rebate, and your tax becomes zero. Now know about the old tax system If you choose the old tax regime, there is no tax on income up to ₹2.5 lakh. On taxable income up to ₹5 lakh, a rebate of ₹12,500 is available under Section 87A. Therefore, no tax needs to be paid. In this regime, you can avail tax exemption benefits like 80C, 80D, HRA. Now, file ITR from home Show different incomes in ITR like this House Rent: According to tax consultant Vinay Tiwari, income from rent must be shown under Income from House Property. The government directly provides a 30% standard deduction on total rent. This means if you receive ₹1 lakh as rent annually, tax will be levied only on ₹70 thousand. If there is a home loan on the same property, an additional exemption of up to ₹2 lakh can be availed on its interest. Bank Interest: Every interest received from bank accounts or FDs must be filled under Income from Other Sources, as it is already recorded in your AIS. Under the old tax regime, common people get an exemption of up to ₹10,000 on savings account interest under Section 80TTA. Meanwhile, senior citizens get an exemption of up to ₹50,000 in total on interest from both FDs and savings under Section 80TTB. Shares and Mutual Funds: Many people think that all data related to shares and mutual funds gets automatically filled in the ITR. Actually, AIS only shows purchase-sale information; you have to calculate the tax yourself. For this, you need to download the Capital Gains Statement from your broker (Zerodha or Groww) and fill in the information yourself. Dividend received from shares must also be shown in Income from Other Sources. Refund not coming? This could be the reason If the refund is not coming after filing the ITR, first check your bank account. Your bank account should be pre-validated on the income tax portal. Also, the name registered in the bank account and the information provided on the PAN portal should match completely. If this is not the case, even after the refund is approved, the money will not come to your account and may get stuck. If tax is zero in Form-16, is it still necessary to file ITR? If Form-16 shows zero tax, don't assume that there's no need to file ITR. Filing ITR depends on whether your total income and financial transactions fall under the rules set by the Income Tax Department. In some cases, filing ITR is mandatory even if no tax is payable. If a taxpayer passes away, will ITR need to be filed? Yes, the legal heir will have to register themselves as a Legal Heir on the income tax portal. For this, they will need to upload the death certificate, PAN, and other necessary documents. After approval, they will file the ITR on behalf of the deceased. If a refund is due, it will come to the verified bank account of the legal heir. According to the Supreme Court, if in the future a person dies in a road accident or becomes permanently disabled, the ITR will be an important basis for determining the compensation amount to be given to their family. In the case of businesspersons, the compensation will be calculated based on the average income of the ITR for the last 3 years.

stories.title: Ram Mandir treasurer says he is 'ashamed' over donation theft:Member claims more accused are involved; exact amount cannot be determined
stories.summary: After the case of theft of offerings at Ram Mandir came to light, the Trust is now preparing for major changes. Swami Govind Dev Giri, the treasurer of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, says that the mistake that happened will not be allowed to happen again. For this, the temple's system will be strengthened. An experienced CEO will be appointed. In a special conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, Swami Govind Dev provided important information regarding the Trust's meeting on July 22, the SIT investigation, and new arrangements for the temple. Read Swami Govind Dev's full interview A new CEO will be appointed to handle administrative arrangements Question- What changes are being made to the temple's management? Govind Dev- Changes in the temple's management and making it better have now become very necessary. We have also fully understood this. To ensure that the mistake made once does not happen again, improvements are being made in all departments. A CEO will be appointed to oversee the entire system and maintain administrative discipline. Question- Why is a CEO needed? Can't the trust members handle this responsibility? Govind Dev- All our trustees and workers are not sufficient to manage such a large system with administrative efficiency and strictness. Therefore, the need for a professional CEO was felt. Question- How and when will the CEO be appointed? Govind Dev- For this, a committee of 3 members has been formed. The committee will interview several people and provide 3 names to the trust. After this, we will select one person from them. The CEO will constantly oversee the management, supervision, and improvement of the temple. The process of selecting the CEO will be completed before the meeting on July 22. This work will be done in a transparent and impartial manner. Question- Will the trust be run on an administrative model like Kashi Vishwanath Dham? Govind Dev- No, the trust will function as before. However, there is a lot of scope for improvement in the system and work will be done in that direction. Question- Is there a plan to change the bank for donations now? Govind Dev- No decision has been made on this yet. This matter will be considered when it comes up in the trust meeting. Big decisions can be made in the July 22 meeting Question- 2 members have resigned from the trust, 1 post is vacant. When will these be filled? Govind Dev- All such decisions are made in the trust meeting. The next meeting is on July 22, and a decision on this will be taken then. Question- You are the treasurer, but you don't always stay in Ayodhya. How will you monitor? Govind Dev- As I said before, this is why a full-time CEO is needed. He will work in Ayodhya at all times. He will manage the entire system according to our instructions and established discipline. The amount of the theft will be known after the SIT report comes Question- Did the trust members never get a hint of this theft? Govind Dev- Personally, I never got any such hint. Even if someone else had some information, it did not reach me. Question- What was Gopal Rao's role in the offering theft? Govind Dev- What his role was in the theft is a subject of SIT investigation. His responsibility was to coordinate the temple's worship, darshan arrangements, and other tasks. I cannot say anything about his role in the theft. Question- Is there a possibility of more people being involved besides the 8 accused? Govind Dev- This possibility cannot be ruled out. When these 8 people were doing all this, there must have been other people watching or assisting. Identifying them is the job of the SIT. Question- There was no account of the offerings. How will it be known how many crores were stolen? Govind Dev- There was an account of the offerings, but the money was removed before it could be recorded. Therefore, it is very difficult to ascertain the exact amount of the theft. Allegations of Conspiracy Against Tinnu Yadav Question - You have accused Tinnu Yadav of conspiracy, who are you hinting at? Govind Dev - Based on news reports in the media, I had said that several calls from outsiders were found on his mobile. This could be true or false. It is a very serious matter for a person who has been working for so many years to do something like this. Question- Nishikant Dubey alleged that there was a conversation between Akhilesh and Tinnu? Govind Dev- I cannot confirm the truth of this. The situation will only become clear after the final report of the SIT is released. Question- How did the accused become so powerful that they even deleted CCTV footage? Govind Dev- How they got so much freedom is a big question. There was not enough surveillance on them, which made this possible. Were the CCTV footage recovered or not? I do not have information about this. Read what Govind Dev Giri has stated so far After allegations of theft of offerings and financial irregularities at Ayodhya Ram Temple, the trust's treasurer, Govind Dev Giri, has been continuously in discussion. He has given several statements on this entire matter so far. Refused to Resign: When journalists questioned him about resignation and accountability, he became angry. He was even seen pulling the microphones of media personnel. He clearly stated - I will not resign, because I have done nothing wrong. Clarified His Role: Regarding the questions arising due to his position as treasurer, Govind Giri said that his responsibility is to manage the audited records of the trust. He stated that he is not directly involved in the daily cash counting or transaction process. Defended Champat Rai: Even before the SIT's preliminary report came out, Govind Giri described the theft of offerings as a 'Jaghanya Mahapaap'. However, he defended the trust's general secretary, Champat Rai, saying that he had no role in it. His only mistake was trusting the wrong person. Offerings declared safe: Govind Giri says that the 2,929 valuable items received as donations by the trust are completely safe. He also said that any donor who wishes can come and see them.

The written examination for the recruitment was conducted on 14th and 15th March 2026. Following the written examination, subsequent stages, and reservation rules, a total of 4,543 candidates have been finally selected. The recruitment board has uploaded the post-wise and category-wise selection list on its official website uppbpb.gov.in. Candidates can also check their final result through the link siupexam25.com/sifinalresults. Congratulating the selected candidates, the board said the normalised marks of all candidates who appeared for the written examination will be released on 22 July 2026. Candidates will be able to check their marks the same day through the link available on the board's official website.

stories.title: Fatwa issued over Aamir's third-marriage:UP mufti calls it invalid, says relationship with non-Muslim woman is a sin
stories.summary: A fatwa concerning Bollywood actor Aamir Khan's third marriage was issued in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, on Tuesday afternoon by Shahi Chief Mufti Maulana Chaudhary Ibrahim Hussain. The Mufti stated that, under Shariat (Islamic law), a Muslim man is not permitted to marry a non-Muslim woman who continues to follow her own religion and has not accepted Islam. He said such a marriage is considered invalid under Islamic law, and a Muslim man entering into it is regarded as committing a religious wrong. 2 pictures of Aamir-Gauri's wedding Karni Sena had accused Aamir of ‘love jihad’ Earlier on Tuesday itself, Thakur Gyanendra Singh, National Vice President of Kshatriya Karni Sena, said, ‘’At the age of 61, a common man retires and wants to live a comfortable life with his family. At that age, Aamir Khan has married a Hindu woman for the third time. He is promoting love jihad by marrying Hindu women every time. He is instigating Muslim youth for this. Thakur Gyanendra Singh had written a letter to the Shahi Chief Mufti asking whether this marriage is correct according to Islam. If this is wrong, then why doesn't Aamir Khan get the punishment that is prescribed for common Muslims? He had warned that the protest will continue until Aamir Khan is punished according to law and religion.'' Now, read what the Mufti said in response... Marriage without conversion is wrong: The Quran clearly states that until a non-Muslim woman accepts faith (i.e., accepts the Muslim religion), do not marry her. If a Muslim person knowingly marries a non-Muslim woman, that marriage will be religiously invalid. Nikah valid only upon accepting Quran and Prophet: The real meaning of a non-Muslim woman embracing faith is that she believes only in Allah. She accepts Hazrat Mohammad as the last Prophet (messenger). Besides this, she must have faith in the Quran and God's holy books. She must live life according to Islamic rules and practices. Deceiving first wife is a sin: Marrying a second time while keeping the first wife in deception is a grave sin. According to the Quran, if a person cannot treat his wives equally, cannot bear their expenses or fulfill their rights, then he is not permitted to marry more than once. Prophet Mohammad Sahab had said that the person who deceives is not one of us. Therefore, committing injustice with the first wife is a great sin. According to Islamic law, there is a difference between the two. Marriage with a Christian or Jewish woman is considered permissible after fulfilling certain necessary conditions. Marrying another non-Muslim woman without religious conversion is completely wrong. This is not a final verdict against any one person: The Mufti explained that this religious opinion (fatwa) that has been given is information about a general rule. This is not our final legal or court decision on Aamir Khan's or any particular person's private life. Karni Sena had asked us questions based on a letter, so we have only provided information about the general rules of Islam. The Mufti clarified what the ground reality is of Aamir Khan's third marriage. Whether that woman accepted Islam before marriage or not is a matter of investigation. The decision to directly declare any person guilty or to punish them can only be taken after examining all evidence and the actual status of the nikah. Aamir-Gauri's wedding took place on July 5 61-year-old Aamir Khan had a registered marriage with Gauri Spratt on July 5. Only a few close guests attended the wedding. After signing the wedding papers, the couple took their vows. During this, Aamir gave Gauri a priceless ring. First divorce happened in 2002 Aamir had his first marriage in 1986 with Reena Dutta. It was a love marriage that lasted for about 16 years. The two have two children, Junaid Khan and Ira Khan. In 2002, both legally separated. Second relationship with Kiran Rao, then separated by mutual consent After the divorce from Reena Dutta, director Kiran Rao came into Aamir Khan's life. Both got married in 2005. From this marriage, they have a son, Azad, who was born through IVF. After 15 years of marriage, in July 2021, Aamir and Kiran announced their divorce.

stories.title: Classmate kills medical student over one-sided love:Accused brings knife in bag; nurse injured while trying to save her
stories.summary: A 20-year-old female student studying at Pilibhit Medical College was stabbed to death by her classmate. After the incident, the accused tried to escape, but the medical college's security guards caught him on the spot and handed him over to the police. According to the police, the incident took place around 9:30 AM in the CT scan room of the medical college. The student, a resident of Bareilly, was in the CT scan room. Just then, a fellow student arrived there. An argument ensued between the two, after which the student pulled out a knife from his bag and repeatedly attacked the female student. The student ran to escape, but the accused chased her and inflicted several blows. A female employee was also injured while intervening. The condition of the student and the employee was deteriorating. Therefore, they were referred to SRMS Hospital (Shri Ram Murti Smarak Institute of Medical Sciences) in Bareilly. Around 2 PM, the student succumbed to her injuries during treatment. Initial investigation revealed that the accused was in one-sided love. Police are interrogating the accused. Meanwhile, paramedical students have gathered in protest after the murder of the student. The student's parents reached the Bareilly post-mortem house. The mother appeared distraught. People were seen comforting her. Now know the full case in detail Accused is a resident of Kanpur According to the police, Kashish Patel (20), a resident of Bareilly, was a CT scan student at Pilibhit Medical College. She arrived at the college around 9 AM on Tuesday morning. She was working with a female employee in the CT scan room. Just then, Sagar Singh (19), a resident of Kanpur who studied with Kashish, also arrived. Sagar is an X-ray technical student. According to fellow students, Kashish and Sagar were in a relationship. They had an argument over something in the morning. Brought a 12-inch knife hidden in his bag According to eyewitnesses, the accused had come prepared for the attack. He had hidden a knife about 12 inches long in his bag. He took out the knife from his bag and attacked Kashish with it right in the CT scan room. Seeing this, female employee Nidhi ran to intervene, but Sagar also attacked her. She was seriously injured by the knife in her hand. The hospital administration admitted both of them and, after primary treatment, referred them to Bareilly. There, Kashish died around 2 PM during treatment. Accused caught before he could escape After committing the crime, the accused student Sagar was trying to escape from the spot, but the security personnel of the medical college showed alertness and caught him on the spot and handed him over to the police. After this, the police have taken the accused into custody and started interrogation. Father said - The accused came to the village about 15-20 days ago In Bareilly, Kashish's father, Rohtas, is a driver. He said that he received information in the morning that a boy named Sagar had attacked his daughter with a knife, and was later caught. He said, "My daughter was pursuing a paramedical course in Pilibhit, and that boy also studied there. He had also come to their village, Kesarpur, about 15-20 days ago. When they reached Pilibhit District Hospital, their daughter's condition was serious. Later, she died." Police investigating rivalry and other aspects SP Sukirti Madhav Mishra said - The student, who was injured in an attack by a paramedical student, died during treatment at a Bareilly hospital. The accused is being interrogated to ascertain the reasons for the murder. Police are now investigating the relationship between the two students, the cause of the dispute, and the circumstances leading up to the incident. CO City Amarnath Verma said that a murder case has been registered against the accused. Police are thoroughly investigating all possible aspects, including rivalry, to present strong evidence against the accused in court. -

stories.title: UP govt to refund excess tax collected from homebuyers:Consumers can apply on GST portal to get their money back
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (UP RERA) has issued fresh guidelines to facilitate refund of excess Goods and Services Tax (GST) collected from homebuyers and directed all registered real estate promoters to strictly adhere to the GST rates notified by the Centre. In a statement issued on Monday, UP RERA said eligible homebuyers who were charged GST in excess of the prescribed rates would be able to claim refunds through the GST department's online mechanism, reported news agency, PTI. GST in all projects registered with UP RERA should be collected only at the rates notified by the Central government. Cases have come to the notice of the authority where GST has been collected from allottees at rates higher than those prescribed. -UP RERA To safeguard the interests of homebuyers, UP RERA said it had coordinated with the State Tax Department to clarify the mechanism for refund of excess GST. Conditions: According to the procedure, if a homebuyer has paid GST while purchasing a flat or availing construction services but the project is cancelled, the agreement is terminated, or the allotment is revoked after the statutory time limit for issuance of a credit note by the promoter has expired, the allottee can directly seek a refund from the GST department. Procedure: For this, an unregistered allottee will have to obtain temporary registration on the GST portal using a Permanent Account Number (PAN) and submit an application in "Form GST RFD-01" under the category "Refund for Unregistered Person." Requisite docs: The refund will be processed after verification by the competent authority under GST provisions. Other conditions: UP RERA said that where the statutory period for issuing a credit note is still available, "the promoter himself shall issue the credit note or refund the entire amount, including GST, to the allottee." Only where the statutory period has expired would the allottee be required to approach the GST department directly. Time limit: The authority said refund claims must be filed within two years from the date of cancellation or termination of the agreement. No refund on GST of less than ₹1,000 The authority clarified that claims involving GST below ₹1,000 would not be entertained. Directing promoters to ensure strict compliance, UP RERA said they should "fully adhere to the notified GST rates and under no circumstances collect GST in excess of the prescribed rates." Wherever excess GST has been collected from an allottee, necessary action shall be taken to ensure refund of the excess amount in accordance with applicable legal provisions and the guidelines issued by the State Tax Department. -UP RERA

stories.summary: Amid the Ayodhya Ram Mandir offering theft case, the names of former general secretary Champat Rai and trustee Dr Anil Mishra have been removed from the website of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust on Tuesday. Earlier, the VIP pass IDs of both had also been blocked. New VIP pass IDs have been issued in the names of interim general secretary Krishna Mohan and trustee Mahant Dinendra Das. Posters targeting the Samajwadi Party were put up late Monday night in several Uttar Pradesh districts, including Ayodhya, Barabanki and Mathura. The posters carry pictures of Mulayam Singh Yadav and Akhilesh Yadav with the message: “Babar in the heart, Ram on the lips.” On Tuesday morning, SP workers tear down the hoardings. In the offering theft case, police will file an application in court on Tuesday seeking the remand of accused Ramshankar Yadav alias Tinnu and Subhash Srivastava. According to sources, police may seek their seven-day remand. If granted, both will be questioned. Earlier, police had taken accused Avinash Shukla, Anukalp Mishra, Lavkush Mishra and Karunesh Pandey on remand and questioned them. The details of Champat Rai and trustee Anil Mishra have been removed from the trust website. Read all updates related to the Ram Mandir case in the live blog.

stories.title: Railway staff protest after officer assault:Women raise slogans against RPF, clash at Agra Cantt station
stories.summary: The matter of the railway officer being dragged and assaulted on the platform in Agra is escalating. On Tuesday, railway employees staged protests in several cities including Agra and Mathura. At around 10 am, more than 500 railway employees came out on the streets in Agra. Women employees raised strong slogans against the Railway Protection Force (RPF). During the protest, a heated confrontation also took place between the protesters and security personnel. Tension prevailed inside the railway station premises. Railway employees demanded the arrest of those responsible. The employees said, “RPF’s hooliganism will not be tolerated. RPF personnel harass people every day and assault them. Strict action should be taken so that no one dares to take the law into their own hands in the future.” The incident took place on Sunday at Agra Cantt railway station, where a dispute broke out between the Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Deputy Station Superintendent (DSS) Narendra Chahar over stopping a train. RPF personnel allegedly assaulted DSS Narendra Chahar and dragged him across the platform. People present at the station recorded the incident on video. After the video surfaced, railway employees became angry. Railway staff from several cities including Kota, Jhansi and Delhi started reaching Agra. Those who could not reach the city staged protests at their respective places of posting and demanded the arrest of the accused. Meanwhile, RPF ASI Meghraj Meena, Bal Kishan and constables Badan Singh and Jitendra were suspended. See pictures of the commotion- Railway launches probe, takes CCTV footage into custody Railway authorities have started an investigation into the assault case involving Deputy Station Superintendent Narendra Chahar at Agra Cantt railway station. On Monday, the investigation team reached the station and took custody of the DVR of CCTV cameras installed on the platform where the incident took place. The footage will now be examined to understand the complete sequence of events. According to railway sources, the investigation team is also closely examining the video that went viral on social media. The case gained momentum after this video surfaced. The team is also trying to contact the woman passenger due to whom the dispute reportedly started. Her statement will be recorded to understand the actual reason behind the incident and establish the complete timeline. Railway forms committee, action to follow after report Railway authorities have formed a committee to investigate the matter. The committee includes the Senior Divisional Operations Manager, Senior Divisional Electrical Engineer and Senior Divisional Security Commissioner (RPF). Railways said strict departmental action will be taken against those found guilty after the committee submits its investigation report. Medical report confirms ruptured eardrum of Deputy SS The medical report of Deputy Station Superintendent Narendra Singh Chahar has surfaced. An examination conducted by the ENT specialist at the district hospital confirmed that Narendra Chahar suffered a rupture of the left eardrum, medically termed tympanic membrane laceration. Four RPF personnel suspended after railway employees’ protest Following the incident involving DSS Narendra Chahar, railway employees gathered outside the RPF police station and raised slogans in protest. The employees alleged that RPF personnel treated the officer in an inhuman manner for helping a female passenger. After the incident, RPF ASI Meghraj Meena, ASI Bal Kishan, Constables Badan Singh and Jitendra were suspended. Two days ago, Deputy Station Superintendent was assaulted at Agra Cantt station The incident took place around 11 am on Sunday, July 12, at Agra Cantt railway station, when RPF personnel allegedly assaulted Deputy Station Superintendent Narendra Chahar. A train named Amritsar-Hirakund Express had arrived at platform number 1 from Amritsar. During this time, a woman passenger got down from the train and started purchasing some items. Meanwhile, the train started moving. The woman passenger tried to board the moving train but failed. Seeing the woman running behind the train, Deputy SS Narendra Chahar informed the loco pilot through a walkie-talkie and got the train stopped. When the train slowed down, the woman tried to board it. At that time, an RPF personnel present at the spot stopped the woman, accusing her of chain pulling. DSS Narendra Chahar objected to this and said that he had stopped the train. However, the RPF personnel did not accept his explanation. A dispute broke out between the two, which escalated into an alleged assault. The RPF personnel called his colleagues to the spot. The RPF personnel allegedly caught hold of DSS Narendra Chahar and tried to take him away. When he resisted, they pushed him to the ground. Chahar remained struggling on the floor, but four RPF personnel allegedly held his hands and legs and dragged him for around 300 metres across the platform. The RPF personnel, however, alleged that DSS Narendra Chahar had abused them and behaved indecently with them. Railway union protests, says ‘RPF high-handedness will not be tolerated’ Railway Union General Secretary Sharad Chandra Purohit reached platform number one of Agra Cantt station at 10:15 am. Station masters welcomed him by putting a garland around his neck. The protest began after this, with slogans raised against the RPF and chants of “down with RPF”. Protesters said, “RPF’s high-handedness will not be tolerated. Give justice to Narendra Chahar.”

After catching fire, the man started running around in panic. Inspector, sub-inspector and police personnel rushed to save him. They covered him with a blanket, pulled him inside the police station and managed to put out the flames. Three policemen suffered burn injuries while trying to rescue him. The man was taken to Ursala Hospital by the police in a serious condition. The man has been identified as Mahesh (32). The incident took place at around 11:10 am on Tuesday. stories.title: Woman alleges molestation by Agra medical store owner:Obscene act in front of minor daughter, accused in custody
stories.summary: A woman has accused the owner of a medical store of molesting her when she went to buy medicines in Agra's Etmadpur police station area. Following the incident, the victim's family members and local residents staged a protest outside the shop. Police reached the spot, detained the store owner and began questioning him. According to the complaint, the woman, a resident of Khandauli police station area, had gone to the medical store in Trans Yamuna Phase 1 with her eight-year-old daughter at around 4:30 pm on Monday to buy medicines. In her written complaint, the woman alleged that the store owner asked her to come inside and sit under the fan after noticing she was feeling uneasy due to the heat. As she was unwell, she went inside and sat down. She alleged that the store owner then molested her. While she was taking out money to pay for the medicines, he allegedly used obscene language and made inappropriate advances. The woman returned home in tears and informed her husband about the incident. Soon afterwards, her family members and local residents reached the medical store and created a ruckus. After receiving information, Dial 112 police reached the spot and pacified the protesters. Police detained the medical store owner and handed him over to the local police outpost for further questioning. The victim has submitted a written complaint, seeking strict legal action against the accused.

stories.title: ₹5 lakh stolen after Creta window smashed:Traders targeted outside their shop, theft caught on CCTV
stories.summary: Miscreants stole a bag containing ₹5 lakh in cash after smashing the window of a marble traders’ car in Gorakhpur on Monday night. The incident took place around 8 pm outside Fatima Hospital when the traders had parked their Hyundai Creta outside their shop and gone inside due to rain. The entire incident was captured on CCTV. Police were informed immediately. Gorakhnath Circle Officer and Shahpur police reached the spot, seized the CCTV footage and launched an investigation. Know the full story Vivek Kumar Nigam, a resident of Gauribazar in Deoria, and Ajit Singh, a resident of Ward No. 21 in Kushinagar, live in a rented house at Shatabdipuram in Shahpur. The two have been running a tiles and marble business under the name Makrana Marble opposite Fatima Hospital for the past seven years. On Monday evening, the traders had gone to Mohaddipur to hand over ₹5 lakh to a person. However, as the person did not arrive, they went to watch a film at Orion Mall. After the show ended around 6:30 pm, they returned to their shop, parked the Creta outside and went inside. Three miscreants carried out the theft Around 7:45 pm, while the traders were preparing to close the shop and leave for home, it started raining. They decided to wait inside the shop for some time. During this period, three men arrived on foot, smashed the rear window of the car and fled with a bag containing ₹5 lakh in cash, ATM cards, Aadhaar cards and other important documents. After the rain stopped, the traders returned to the car and found the window broken. On discovering the bag missing, they searched for the accused along with their employees in the Khajanchi Crossing, Medical College and Asuran areas, but could not trace them. They then informed the police. CCTV footage under examination Shahpur police and Gorakhnath Circle Officer Ravi Kumar Singh reached the spot after receiving the information. Police inspected the scene, seized the DVR of the CCTV cameras installed at the shop and began examining the footage as part of the investigation.

stories.title: BHU to hold 2 spot rounds for PG admissions:8,400 seats across 150 courses, classes begin July 30
stories.summary: The admission process for postgraduate (PG) courses at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) has entered its final stage. Considering the large number of candidates registering for the spot round, the university’s Central Admission Committee has decided to conduct two spot admission rounds. Tuesday is the last day for PG spot registration. Seat allotment and seat-locking for the first spot round will begin on July 16. 8400 seats available in 150 courses BHU had earmarked a total of 8,400 seats this year across more than 150 postgraduate programmes. Around 6,000 seats have already been filled in the four regular allotment rounds. Nearly 2,400 seats are still vacant, including those under various reserved categories, foreign student quota, BHU employee family quota and other supernumerary categories. Based on the number of registrations received on the BHU Samarth portal, the university has decided to conduct two spot seat allotment rounds. The first spot allotment round will begin on July 16, while the second will continue until July 20. Classes will start from July 30 According to the admission schedule, call letters will be issued on students’ portals from July 22. Candidates allotted seats in the first round and GDPI round must report to their respective departments and colleges on July 27. Candidates allotted seats in the second, third and fourth rounds, along with all spot rounds, will report on July 28. Postgraduate classes will commence from July 30. Slow Portal Speed Becomes a Source of Trouble Meanwhile, the slow performance of the admission portal continues to hamper undergraduate (UG) registrations at BHU. Apart from heavy server load, the process of fetching candidate data from the National Testing Agency (NTA) on the Samarth portal has also been sluggish. As a result, many applicants are waiting for the registration process to become smoother before completing their applications. However, candidates have time until July 25 to complete UG admission registration.

stories.title: Merchant Navy employee stabs father to death:Children’s dispute triggers attack; neighbours catch accused, lock him in room
stories.summary: A Merchant Navy employee allegedly stabbed his government employee father to death in Uttar Pradesh’s Lakhimpur Kheri on Monday evening around 4 pm. According to family members, the accused first pushed his father down, then sat on his chest and stabbed him six times. Police investigation has revealed that the accused had a dispute with the daughters of his elder brother during a game. When the father tried to resolve the children’s argument, the accused arrived and got into an argument with him. The dispute escalated, following which he attacked his father with a knife. Rajiv Awasthi fell unconscious in a pool of blood. After the attack, accused son Akash Awasthi (36) tried to flee, but family members and neighbours caught him and locked him inside a room. Police reached the spot after receiving information and arrested the accused. The incident took place in Sadar Kotwali area. Relatives and neighbours rushed injured Rajiv Awasthi (57) to the district hospital, where he died during treatment. Rajiv Awasthi was a clerk in the Animal Husbandry Department. His son Akash has been working as a store in-charge in the Merchant Navy for the past 15 years. Accused son had come home on leave 14 days ago Rajiv Awasthi lived with his family in Hathipur village. His son Akash had come home on leave on June 30. Akash’s elder brother Vineet died of cancer in 2020. Since then, his children had been living with their grandfather. Akash’s mother Vibh Awasthi said, “Akash often had fights with his wife Priya. Because of this, he remained angry.” ‘He sat on his father’s chest and attacked him with a knife’ Grandmother Vibha Awasthi said that on Monday evening, Akash and Vineet’s daughters had a fight over some issue. An argument broke out in the house over the same matter. She said, “I was making tea when my grandson Akash came downstairs from the upper floor in anger. He first argued with his father and then attacked him with a knife.” “I heard the noise and rushed to the spot. I saw my grandson sitting on Rajiv’s chest and stabbing him.” ‘When we snatched one knife, he brought another and attacked again’ The grandmother said, “I and other family members tried to stop him. After a lot of effort, we managed to snatch the first knife from his hand. But he immediately went inside, brought another knife and attacked him again.” “Even three-four people together could not stop him. First my grandson died, and now my son is gone. After the incident, daughter-in-law Priya also left for her maternal home with the children and belongings. Our family has lost its support.” Neighbours caught accused and locked him inside room Hearing screams from the house, neighbours reached the spot. They, along with family members, caught Akash and locked him inside the house. Sadar Kotwali Inspector Rajesh Kumar Singh said, “The preliminary investigation suggests that the murder took place after a domestic dispute. The body has been sent for postmortem. Further action will be taken based on the postmortem report, forensic examination and questioning.”

stories.title: Accused who thrashed couple in Gorakhpur over road dispute apologise:Hold ears, plead at station; say 'won't repeat mistake'
stories.summary: The accused who allegedly pulled a couple out of their car, assaulted them and looted their mobile phone in Gorakhpur started pleading for mercy as soon as they were caught by police. They held their hands and ears, apologising and saying, “Sir, we made a big mistake. This will never happen again. We will never get involved in any fight. Please forgive us once.” The accused have been identified as Abhishek Madheshia and Kundan Madheshia, residents of Maharajganj. Kundan is disabled in his left hand. Police identified and arrested both accused on Monday evening at around 9 pm with the help of the viral video, CCTV footage and surveillance. Police are searching for the remaining four accused. Know the full story A young man from Noida works at a hotel in the city. A woman from Jharkhand also works with him. The two are friends. After finishing their duty on Thursday night, July 9, the two went out in a car after dinner towards Nauka Vihar and Taal Ring Road for a drive. According to reports, their car narrowly avoided a collision with a bike on Taal Ring Road towards Mohaddipur. After this, the bike riders called their associates. The victim said that six youths arrived on three bikes and stopped their car. They allegedly started misbehaving with them. When they protested, the accused abused and assaulted them, snatched their mobile phone and damaged the car windows. Hearing the commotion, nearby people reached the spot. The accused fled after seeing people gathering there. During the incident, some people recorded videos, which surfaced on Saturday night, July 11. See 3 pictures Victims wandered for two and a half hours in border dispute After the incident, passers-by took the man and woman to a police outpost under Cantt police station. There, police allegedly sent them to another outpost saying the incident did not fall under their jurisdiction. The victims then reached Cantt police station, from where they were again sent to Mohaddipur outpost. From around 11:30 pm to 2 am, the victims kept visiting police stations and outposts seeking action. Later, after intervention by a senior police officer, police became active. The team reached the spot, investigated the matter and put the stolen mobile phone on surveillance. The incident could have escalated if passers-by had not arrived Sanjay Paswan, who was present at the spot, shared the video of the incident on social media. He said passers-by intervened at the right time and saved the couple, otherwise the situation could have become more serious. He also said that he would provide videos related to the incident and other evidence to the police. Earlier, a couple was also harassed According to local residents, the same bike-borne youths who created a ruckus in the Nauka Vihar area had earlier misbehaved with another couple. The couple had recorded the incident on video. The accused fled after people gathered at the spot. Later, when the couple came to know about the assault and mobile theft involving the Noida youth, they also reached the police outpost and station along with the victims. SP City Nimish Patil said- Two accused have been arrested in the case. Search for other accused is ongoing. Based on the victim's complaint, an FIR has been registered under sections of wrongful restraint, voluntarily causing hurt, insult, vandalism, and robbery, and further action is being taken.

stories.title: Suspended municipal employee dies by suicide:6-page note recovered, accuses EO of demanding ₹6.19 lakh bribe for job restoration; wife breaks down
stories.summary: A suspended Nagar Palika employee in Uttar Pradesh’s Pilibhit allegedly died by suicide by hanging himself inside his room. Around 5:30 pm on Monday, his wife entered the room and found him hanging from a ceiling hook. She collapsed on seeing him and started crying loudly. Hearing her screams, other family members reached the spot and informed the police. Police reached the house, brought the body down and sent it for post-mortem. During the inspection of the room, a six-page suicide note was recovered. In the note, the employee alleged that an officer had taken ₹6 lakh as a bribe on the promise of getting his job restored but did not do the work. He also alleged that the officer abused him and demanded strict punishment. The incident took place in Durga Prasad locality under Bisalpur police station. The deceased, tax collector Upendra Shankhdhar (52), had been suspended last year over allegations of embezzlement of ₹30 lakh during tax collection. He was later sent to jail in September 2025. After spending five months in jail, he was released on bail in January this year. His wife, who was doing household work, opened the door and found his body hanging from the ceiling hook. She raised an alarm, following which family members gathered at the spot. Police reached the location, sent the body for post-mortem and inspected the room. A six-page suicide note was found from the room. The employee had gone to jail eight months ago in a case related to alleged tax collection embezzlement at the municipality and had recently come out on bail. In the suicide note, he levelled serious allegations against the Nagar Palika administration. He claimed that despite allegedly giving a share of the money in the tax scam, he was still sent to jail. The employee also accused the department’s Executive Officer (EO) of taking ₹6.19 lakh as bribe. He held the EO responsible for his suicide and demanded action against him. Police have taken the suicide note into custody, while the EO has termed all allegations baseless. Got job after father’s death Upendra Shankhdhar, a resident of Bisalpur, was a fourth-class employee at Nagar Palika Parishad. In 2004, he got the job of tax collector under the deceased dependent quota after the death of his father Rajendra Pujari. He lived with his wife Shashi and his younger brother’s family. In September 2025, Nagar Palika EO Shamsher Singh had registered a case of alleged tax scam against tax collector Upendra Shankhdhar, Jitendra, Ramniwas and two former officials. The case alleged irregularities in the collection of house tax and water tax. The EO had dismissed all of them from service with immediate effect. After coming out on bail, Upendra stayed at home and ran a small grocery shop to support his family. He was also making rounds of officials seeking reinstatement of his job. ‘Had already paid ₹6 lakh bribe, he demanded ₹8 lakh more’ Upendra’s brother Anurag said that Upendra was at home around 5:30 pm on Monday. Everything was normal in the morning. Later in the afternoon, Nagar Palika EO Shamsher Singh called him, after which he became extremely disturbed. According to the family, Upendra told them that he had already paid ₹6 lakh to the officer by selling his wife’s jewellery and family land to get his job restored. He alleged that the officer was now demanding another ₹8 lakh. The family said Upendra told them that he had already lost everything and arranging such a large amount was impossible for him. They tried to console him and advised him to complain about the matter, but due to mental stress, he allegedly hanged himself in his room around 5:30 pm. Upendra’s wife Shashi said she was doing household work in the evening when she opened the room door and found his body hanging from the ceiling hook. The family informed police, who reached the spot and recovered a six-page suicide note from the room. Two pages of the note have surfaced, in which Upendra made several allegations against EO Shamsher Singh. Read the suicide note “I am going to end my life by my own choice. My family members and relatives are not responsible for my death in any way. The reason behind my suicide is EO Shamsher Singh. I allege that he took money from me but did not get my work done. He also abused me using filthy language. I request my MP, MLA and chairman to take strict action against EO Shamsher Singh and ensure he is punished. EO Shamsher Singh used to say that even if I complained against him to the MLA or Chief Minister, nothing would happen to him. I request my MLA to take my suicide case seriously. He used to say that nobody could harm him under the BJP government. He also claimed that when he was EO in Dibai, Bulandshahr, a junior engineer had died by suicide, but no action was taken against him. He used to say that since both the government and chairman belonged to the BJP, he had nothing to worry about. Large Baboo Akram Khan was also involved in the money transactions between me and the EO. I allege that Akram Khan was also supposed to receive some commission from the amount. After this, I received a notice stating that I had to deposit the remaining amount allegedly involved in the embezzlement within 15 days, otherwise a recovery certificate (RC) would be issued. Audits were conducted every year from 2004 to 2025, but no complaint of embezzlement against me was found in any audit. Despite this, the EO accused me and removed me from my job. I am forced to end my life because I am troubled by my circumstances.” Know in which case and when he went to jail In September 2025, Nagar Palika EO Shamsher Singh registered a case of tax scam against tax collector Upendra Shankhdhar, Jitendra, Ramniwas and two former officials. The case alleged that more than ₹30 lakh was embezzled during the collection of house tax and water tax. In the same month, Upendra and his fellow employees were sent to jail. Services of Upendra, Ramniwas and Jitendra were terminated with immediate effect. After spending five months in jail, Upendra got bail in January. Since then, he had been staying at home and running a small grocery shop. Gave bribe by selling land and wife's jewelry Bisalpur Station House Officer (SHO) Sanjeev Kumar Shukla said that the body has been sent for post-mortem. He said the case appears to be related to suicide due to mental stress and all aspects are being investigated. The SHO said the suicide note claimed that ₹6.19 lakh was paid as a bribe to an officer, which was arranged by selling land and the wife’s jewellery. The suicide note holds the Executive Officer responsible for the suicide and demands action against him. Police have taken the note into custody and further legal action will be taken after receiving a complaint.

stories.title: Update Aadhaar details from home in just 3 steps:Change address, mobile number yourself, email update free for 6 months
stories.summary: You no longer need to visit an Aadhaar centre to change your address, mobile number or email ID. These details can now be updated from home using a smartphone through the new Aadhaar app. However, your mobile number must be linked with your Aadhaar card. What to do to change address Download the new Aadhaar app on your mobile phone. Open the app and log in using your Aadhaar number. Complete identity verification. After logging in, go to the Services section on the home page and select the Address Update option. Two options will appear. 1. Update Aadhaar address through government documents Through this option, you can change your Aadhaar address using any valid address proof. First, upload a legal document showing your new address. You will have to complete face authentication and pay a fee of ₹75. If all details are found correct, your application will be sent to UIDAI. After submission, you will receive an SRN (Service Request Number). You can use this number to check your address update status online anytime. The new address will be updated in around 15 days. 2. Update address through a family member’s Aadhaar If you do not have an address proof in your own name, you can use the Head of Family (HoF) option. Under this facility, the address registered in the Aadhaar of a family member such as a husband, wife, father or mother can be updated in your Aadhaar. For this, you will need the Aadhaar number of the family member, proof of your relationship with them and required documents. After this, face authentication will have to be completed. If all details are correct, an approval request will be sent to the family member. Once they approve it, UIDAI will process your application. After this, you will receive an SRN number to track the application status. Avoid mistakes, otherwise your own address may get changed Suppose your wife’s Aadhaar currently has her parental home address and you want to update it to your home address. In this case, you must log in using your wife’s Aadhaar. If you accidentally log in using your own Aadhaar and verify through your wife’s Aadhaar under the Head of Family option, do not accept the approval request received on her phone. If you approve it, your address will be changed to the address mentioned in your wife’s Aadhaar. If such a mistake happens, do not accept the approval request for 30 days. The application will automatically get rejected and the ₹75 fee will be refunded to your account. How to change mobile number The new Aadhaar app now also allows users to update their mobile number. However, the process depends on whether the old mobile number linked with Aadhaar is active or not. If the old mobile number linked with Aadhaar is active and you have logged into the Aadhaar app using the same number, you only need to verify through the OTP received on the new mobile number. If the old mobile number linked with Aadhaar is active but you have logged into the app using another number, OTP verification will be required on both the old and new mobile numbers. If the old mobile number linked with Aadhaar is inactive or no mobile number was ever linked, this facility will not be available online. In such cases, you will have to visit the nearest Aadhaar centre and update or register the mobile number after biometric verification. How to update email ID You can now add or update your email ID in Aadhaar from home using your mobile phone. UIDAI started this facility on the new Aadhaar app from July 1, 2026. The service will be free until December 31, 2026. Earlier, users had to pay ₹75 for updating their email ID. According to UIDAI, more than 2.5 lakh people updated their email IDs within two days of the app launch. Once an email ID is linked with Aadhaar, users will receive information through email whenever their Aadhaar is used. This will help reduce the risk of misuse and fraud. Other important Aadhaar updates you should not ignore Children’s biometric update After a child’s Aadhaar is created, the first biometric update is mandatory at the age of 5 years and the second at the age of 15 years. Both updates are completely free. If these updates are not completed on time, the child’s Aadhaar profile may be suspended. Aadhaar older than 10 years needs an update If your Aadhaar is 10 years old and you have never updated any details, you should upload identity and address documents again. This will keep government records updated and ensure there are no issues while availing government schemes.

stories.title: Gyanvapi-Shringar Gauri mediation meeting today:Hindu side seeks entire temple; Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee refuses to attend
stories.summary: The Hindu and Muslim sides in the Gyanvapi Mosque-Shringar Gauri case are set to appear before a Varanasi court today following the Supreme Court’s directions. The court has asked both parties to remain present before the court at 2 pm on Tuesday. In this case, the Hindu side is seeking complete rights over the entire Gyanvapi Mosque premises and is not willing to opt for mediation. Meanwhile, the Muslim side, represented by the Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee, has distanced itself from the entire process and expressed hope that the matter will be decided through the court proceedings. In the Gyanvapi-Shringar Gauri suit, the Supreme Court had proposed mediation in the matter and issued notices to all parties. The notice stated that all parties should appear before the district judge at the Civil Court’s Mediation Centre on July 14 and try to resolve the matter through mediation. The Hindu side has expressed displeasure over the mediation proposal. It has maintained that the issue concerns the entire Gyanvapi premises. The Muslim side’s lawyer has refused to give up the mosque under any circumstances. Meanwhile, the Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee has decided that it will not participate in the proposed resolution programme at any level. Following the notice issued by the Supreme Court, the Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee has released a letter. Anjuman Intezamia issued a letter Following the Supreme Court’s notice and mediation proposal, a letter has been issued by the Joint Secretary of the Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee. The letter clearly states that the Supreme Court’s invitation for mediation is not binding. Therefore, the committee has decided that it will not participate in the resolution programme at any level. Know what is written in Anjuman Intezamia's letter... The letter states: “The Honourable Supreme Court has initiated the resolution programme to reduce the burden of lakhs of pending cases in various courts and settle disputes through mutual consent. Under this initiative, cases pending at district courts, High Courts and the Supreme Court level are to be resolved through Lok Adalats on the basis of mutual agreement.” “It has also included an extremely sensitive matter like the Gyanvapi Mosque case in this initiative. Due to prominent media coverage of the Gyanvapi Mosque issue, this matter has become a topic of discussion.” “It is not necessary to mention this separately. This invitation is also not binding. Therefore, the Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee has decided that it will not participate in this resolution programme at any level.” Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee Joint Secretary SM Yasin said that the committee would not participate in the mediation process. Daily Bhaskar spoke to Hindu-side plaintiff Laxmi Devi and representative Sohan Lal Arya, along with Anjuman Intezamia Masajid Committee advocate Ekhlak Ahmed, to understand their views on the matter. First, let's know what the Hindu side said We don't want mediation, we want the complete temple One of the five female petitioners in the Gyanvapi-Shringar Gauri case, Laxmi Devi, said: “Our case regarding Gyanvapi has been going on in the Supreme Court since 2022. Now a notice has come asking us to sit with the Muslim side and resolve the matter through mediation. However, we want the entire Gyanvapi. We do not know whether the Muslim side will agree to this or not.” Laxmi Devi made it clear that they do not want mediation. She said they want the case to continue or the Supreme Court to give them rights and an order. “We want our entire Gyanvapi temple. Evidence proves that it is a temple,” she said. 92-day ASI survey reveals it is a temple Laxmi Devi said that after their legal efforts, the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) survey was conducted inside the mosque premises for 92 days in 2022. She said, “A lot of evidence was found during the survey. The survey report also says that there are remains of a temple and that it is a temple itself. On May 16, the presence of Baba was also found in the wazukhana, after which the area was sealed. This came as good news for us that this is our temple.” She further said, “During the court commission survey, we had gone inside and climbed up to see inside the dome. A cap-like structure has only been placed on the top. The temple’s shikhar (spire) still exists there.” The Muslim side always creates obstacles When asked what she would do if the Muslim side did not take a positive stand during mediation, Laxmi Devi said: “The Muslim side has always created hurdles in everything. Whether it was the ASI survey or the court commission survey, they objected everywhere. This is nothing new.” She added, “If a solution comes out, it is fine. Otherwise, we will take our Gyanvapi temple through the court.” Now know what the Muslim side's advocate, Advocate Ekhlaq Ahmad, said Everyone has been called to the Meditation Center on July 14 “In four cases related to Gyanvapi, the Supreme Court has sent a notice to explore whether these matters can be resolved through mutual consent. Everyone has been called on July 14, that is tomorrow. The notice process has been going on for the last two months.” He said, “All parties will appear at the Mediation Centre on July 14. We have gone there three or four times earlier as well, but the Hindu side did not appear.” Give up claim on mosque, mediation will happen Advocate Ekhlak Ahmed said: “Mediation is possible only on one condition — that they withdraw their claim over the mosque because it is thousands of years old. Evidence regarding this exists. Under no circumstances will we give up the mosque. Leaving the mosque is not possible in any situation.” He added, “They do not have any evidence. The ASI survey report has not reached its final disposal. In such a situation, how can they make a claim?” Hindu side representative says they will appear on July 14 Hindu side representative Sohan Lal Arya said: “We have received a notice from the Supreme Court that through mediation, both sides — Hindu and Muslim parties — should sit at one table and present their views so that a solution to the Gyanvapi issue can be found.” He said, “Everyone has to appear before the district judge on July 14. On that day, we will clearly tell the district judge that Gyanvapi temple belongs to us. The Muslim community should give up its claim over it.” He added, “Our stand in one line is that the Muslim side should leave its claim.” Our demand is clear, people of Muslim community should leave Gyanvapi temple Sohan Lal Arya said: “The Muslim community has no right to oppose this because the court commission has already been conducted. The ASI survey has also been completed. All evidence is available.” He claimed, “ASI officials themselves had said that there is no Islamic structure there, but it is a Hindu temple.” Sohan Lal Arya welcomed the Supreme Court’s initiative and said that the court also wants this issue to be resolved. He said, “The Muslim side will also be present before us. What demand they will make is not clear. But our demand is clear — this is our temple and they should leave their claim.” There is no question of giving land here When Sohan Lal Arya was asked about the possibility of giving land to the Muslim side in exchange for the mosque, he said: “The matter is not clear yet. In the Mathura case also, we are petitioners and the situation there was clear. That is why we had said that the structure should be removed from there and we would give them land for a mosque.” “However, the situation here is not clear. We are not going to give them land here. The government and the Supreme Court can take any decision from their side,” he added. Sohan Lal Arya said that four female petitioners, Hindu-side representatives and the Muslim side would be present during the mediation process. He said, “This is important because the Supreme Court has asked us to do this and we have been recalled three times for it. Therefore, on July 14, all of us will reach the Mediation Centre and present our views.” Now know at a glance when the case was filed...

stories.title: BSP leader murder accused killed in encounter:UP STF shot Mustafizul twice; had escaped police custody by jumping from train
stories.summary: A ₹1 lakh reward criminal accused of murdering a BSP leader was killed in an encounter by the Uttar Pradesh STF in Gorakhpur on Monday night at 11:15 pm. When the STF and police teams tried to stop him, he allegedly opened fire. In the retaliatory firing, he suffered bullet injuries near his leg and eye. He died during treatment at the hospital. The encounter took place at Ramnagar Karjaha, around 10 km from the district headquarters. The exchange of fire lasted for nearly 30 minutes, during which 15 rounds were fired from both sides. The accused, Mustafizul, had allegedly murdered BSP leader Kalamuddin alias Kamalu four years ago. Kalamuddin had contested the Assembly election on a BSP ticket. Mustafizul frequently changed his locations, making it difficult for police to arrest him. In December 2024, police had arrested Mustafizul from Gujarat, but while he was being taken to Azamgarh, he escaped from a moving train near Amravati railway station in Maharashtra on the pretext of going to the toilet. Mustafizul was a resident of Mehnagar police station area in Azamgarh. Ten cases, including murder and robbery, were registered against him in Azamgarh, Hardoi and Maharashtra. See pictures related to the encounter Accused opened fire when stopped, killed in retaliatory firing The STF and police had received information that Mustafizul was travelling towards Kushinagar. Following this, STF and police teams started checking vehicles on the Ramnagar-Karjaha four-lane road. Around 11 pm, Mustafizul arrived on a motorcycle. The team signalled him to stop, but he allegedly turned the bike around and tried to flee. When police chased him, he opened fire. One bullet hit STF head constable Mahendra Singh. After this, police retaliated. Mustafizul suffered two bullet injuries and fell on the road. Police brought both the injured constable and the accused to the Khorabar Primary Health Centre (PHC). Mustafizul died during treatment at around 1 am. Police recovered a .32 bore pistol, a motorcycle and cartridges from the spot. UP STF and police carried out the encounter of accused criminal Mustafizul.
